No hat on anyone. Garments must be black, grey, gold, white or charcoal only: never navy or blue (blue is reserved for hair). Keep the original face skin shade and skin shading. Both small hands clearly separated from the body with a little magenta gap between arm and torso. Crisp clean outlines. The output is a single high-quality flat 2D game asset sheet, NOT a poster, NOT a scene, NOT 3D.
